title: Programmatic advertising on TV is set to increase this year

facts.fact: Comcast reports that the number of advertisers running programmatic TV ads increased 14% in the first half of 2025 compared with 2024.
facts.quote: Per Comcast, the number of advertisers running programmatic TV ads increased 14% in the first half of 2025, compared with 2024.

facts.fact: Comcast reports that ad views from new advertisers rose 29% in the first half of 2025 compared with 2024; the article notes exact figures were not specified.
facts.quote: ad views from new advertisers rose 29% in the same period. Exact figures were not specified.

facts.fact: In an October survey conducted by FreeWheel, 56% of advertisers said more programmatic live event inventory would drive an increase in streaming investment.
facts.as_of: October (survey year not stated on page)
facts.quote: 56% of advertisers said more programmatic live event inventory

facts.fact: Disney's programmatic sales increased 30% between 2024 and 2025.
facts.quote: Disney’s programmatic sales increased 30% between 2024 and 2025

facts.fact: Disney was set to release its Q4 results on Feb. 2, the week after the article's publication.
facts.quote: which is set to release its Q4 results next week (Feb. 2)

facts.fact: The 2026 Winter Olympics will be staged in Italy from Feb. 6 to 22.
facts.quote: this year’s Winter games will be staged in Italy, from Feb. 6 to 22.

facts.fact: Netflix has inked programmatic partnerships with the Amazon and Yahoo DSPs.
facts.quote: Netflix inked partnerships with Amazon and Yahoo’s DSPs, for example.

facts.fact: Bob Iger, Disney CEO, told analysts in mid-November that the company is attracting both more advertising and new advertisers to its service.
facts.quote: “We’re attracting both more advertising and new advertisers to the service,” CEO Bob Iger told analysts in mid-November.
